text:
Aisha: Need one quick async on pilot acceptance ops before outreach tomorrow. TL;DR: finalize checklist, scoring owner, and stagger plan.
Sam: fine. I'll own scoring. My rubric: impact(0-5), infra-fit(0-3), data-ready(0-2), legal-risk(0-2). Top 8 gets invites + 3 alternates.
Tara: Outreach copy: highlight 4-week pilot, priority tuning windows, and a post-pilot outcomes workshop. Keep it short.
Neil: From ML: require 5 canonical prompts + expected outputs and a 2-week midpoint eval. Automated diffs + 10-sample human spot check.
Josh: Infra: must stagger partner starts by >=1 week to avoid KV cache/backpressure. I'll publish a capacity calendar and per-partner token keys with cost caps.
Priya: Legal: include anonymization-by-default for example reuse, opt-out available. Add KMS confirmation and no-PHI clause.
Mina: CS: need a 1-page onboarding checklist for each partner (contacts, prompts, kickoff slots, KMS ack). I'll own CS handoff.
CS-bot: (link) pilot template: https://redwood.example/pilot-template
Aisha: Draft acceptance checklist (short): signed pilot MOU; 5 prompts + baselines uploaded; kickoff calls scheduled; success metrics agreed (1 quantitative + 2 qualitative); weekly 30m sync contact; KMS/data handling confirmed; anonymization opt-out flag set.
Sam: Add rollback guardrail: if primary-prompt quality drops >5% or error rate >1.5% for 12h -> pause and investigate.
Neil: Agreed. Also run mid-pilot short report at 2 weeks to decide extend/convert/rollback.
Josh: Ops action: expose per-partner dashboard with token-level cost + alert at 80% cap. I'll add a soft throttle toggle.
Tara: Email snippet: "Hi <Partner>, we'd love to run a brief 4-week pilot to tune Redwood for your workload. Pilot includes prioritized tuning, weekly metrics, and a post-pilot outcomes session. Interested?"
Priya: Also add consent checkbox for public case study; offer a small incentive (discount or credits) if they opt in. Draft contract language incoming.
Mina: CS will collect success metric from partner during intake so we can evaluate ROI after pilot.
Aisha: Owners: Sam=scoring, Tara=outreach copy + email sends, Josh=capacity calendar + tokens, Neil=eval dashboard + mid-pilot report, Priya=legal MOU + consent language, Mina=CS onboarding. I'll assemble final invite pack.
Aisha: If no objections by EOD we'll publish the invite list and start staggered scheduling Monday. Please react with :thumbsup: if good.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Tara: :thumbsup:
Neil: :thumbsup:
Josh: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Mina: :thumbsup:
Aisha: Thanks — I'll post the scored list once ready.
